content: Render free web services spin down after 15 minutes with no inbound traffic (officially documented). Cold start on next request takes roughly 30-60 seconds while Render restarts the container; Render shows a loading page during this window. No supported way to prevent this on free tier other than upgrading to a paid instance (/mo+). Common community workaround is an external uptime pinger hitting a lightweight /health route every ~5-10 min, but this is explicitly a workaround (against ToS spirit in some interpretations) not a guaranteed production fix and can break if Render changes policy.
